name: unity-controller
description: Edit a selected external Unity project, including scenes, objects, built-in components, assets, animation, physics, rendering and UI. Supports repair, undo/redo, clearing logs, project-local captures and batches of 20. A separate tool runs an Editor menu by path after a fresh host confirmation for that call. Approved callbacks inherit Unity's file, network and process permissions. Direct document and Blender tools remain blocked. Returns selected project IDs, numbers and flags. See the full operation list.

settings.title: Unity project hash or Name@hash
settings.description: Copy the project hash from unity_controller_instances. An existing exact Name@hash remains valid.
